column1: # Buddy's command corpus: one source for recording prompts (deploy/record.sh), brain's regression test
#   set       train = recorded for training, test = rephrasings recorded only for the test session,
#             wake = the wake word (recorded on its own, repeated)
#   sentence  written the way it should be transcribed: digits for numbers ("50%"), real capitalisation
#   intent    what brain must return; unknown = no skill for it yet (lights: kept for speech-to-text)
#   query     brain's query for that intent, empty if none
# Replace the artists, songs and playlists with yours: names whisper gets wrong are where training helps most,
# so give each name 5+ sentences across train and test. A new phrasing that brain doesn't know fails ctest
